warning: Values are normalized visual-envelope estimates from manually annotated catalog images. They are not joint spacing or physical dimensions.

references.style_observation: Standard-height body with extremely broad upper visual envelope and narrow waist/lower-body transition.
Tall anatomical body with broad shoulders but stronger chest-to-waist taper than Giant.
Broad Giant mass remains wide through waist/lower body; much less anatomical taper than Alpha 7 cm.
Large-height figure with comparatively standard-like torso/lower-body proportions and a large relative head.
Armor dominates silhouette; shoulder outer span is unusable as a proxy for mechanical shoulder pivot.

derived_lessons: Visual upper-body mass must be modeled independently from shoulder joint spacing.
Alpha AF325 and LEGO Giant can have similarly extreme upper-body presence while differing strongly in stature and waist/lower-body treatment.
Alpha AF345's large shoulder span coexists with a much narrower normalized waist than LEGO Giant.
KDL K2302 reinforces that tall scale does not imply Hulk/Giant-like upper-body mass.
Axl must be fitted as skeleton + armor overlay, not as one broad skeletal torso.
